command:
set -eu
sudo install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/secure-volume
sudo fallocate -l 512M /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
sudo install -m 0400 /dev/null /etc/secure-volume.key
sudo dd if=/dev/urandom of=/etc/secure-volume.key bs=64 count=1 status=none
sudo cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks1 --batch-mode --key-file /etc/secure-volume.key /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
sudo cryptsetup isLuks /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
sudo stat -c 'BACKING=%n SIZE=%s MODE=%a' /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
sudo stat -c 'KEY=%n MODE=%a OWNER=%U:%G BYTES=%s' /etc/secure-volume.key

command:
set -eu
sudo chmod 0600 /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img
sudo cryptsetup open --type luks --key-file /etc/secure-volume.key /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img secure
sudo mkfs.ext4 -q -L secure /dev/mapper/secure
sudo install -d -m 0750 /srv/secure
sudo mount /dev/mapper/secure /srv/secure
sudo sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "encrypted-volume-ready" > /srv/secure/health.txt'
sudo chmod 0640 /srv/secure/health.txt
findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /srv/secure
sudo cryptsetup status secure
sudo cat /srv/secure/health.txt

command:
set -eu
sudo sed -i '\|^secure[[:space:]]|d' /etc/crypttab
sudo sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "secure /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img /etc/secure-volume.key luks" >> /etc/crypttab'
sudo sed -i '\|[[:space:]]/srv/secure[[:space:]]|d' /etc/fstab
sudo sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "/dev/mapper/secure /srv/secure ext4 defaults 0 2" >> /etc/fstab'
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
printf '%s\n' '--- crypttab entry ---'
sudo grep '^secure[[:space:]]' /etc/crypttab
printf '%s\n' '--- fstab entry ---'
sudo grep '[[:space:]]/srv/secure[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab
printf '%s\n' '--- generated units ---'
systemctl cat systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service | sed -n '1,80p'
systemctl cat srv-secure.mount | sed -n '1,60p'

[Unit]
